subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Suddenly, she jumped up and _________ his arm.
solution:
The correct answer is **grabbed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Grab:** to take something with a sudden movement.
 
• **Capture: **to take control of something.
 
• **Snatch: **to take
